description: Read the published public-root metadata at https://councilof.ai/root.json. Returns merkle_root, card_count, as_of, kind and note. VALID means the JSON was retrieved; it does not verify a signature or a measurement. UNREACHABLE means the root response could not be read. Separate from GSPC measurement. Never a certificate.
name: get_root

state.description: VALID: JSON retrieved, not cryptographically verified. UNREACHABLE: the root response could not be read.

title: Public Merkle root
